check_lean_code: check Lean code via the REPL and return structured results with errors, warnings, and sorries
check_lean_code_with_context: check Lean code with all tactics enabled to get goal states at error locations
verify_lean_compilation: verify that Lean code compiles cleanly or with sorries and return a boolean and message
split_lean_imports_and_body: split Lean source code into its import header lines and remaining body code
format_check_result_for_agent: format a CheckResult into agent-friendly markdown showing compilation errors, sorries, and warnings
